name: OneLens
description:
OneLens connects your cloud-cost and FinOps data to Claude. Ask about spend in plain English and get real answers from your live OneLens analytics — no dashboards, no field names to memorize.
Query across AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI and cross-cloud allocation views: list your cost sources and dimensions, break spend down by service, account, region, tag, or cost center, see top-N drivers, month-over-month deltas, and daily trends, and drill from account → service → region → SKU.
Read-only and secure: you sign in with your OneLens account via OAuth; every query is scoped to your organization and honored by your existing entitlements. The connector stores no cost data and never logs cost values. Your OneLens admin controls who can use it and can revoke access instantly.
Requires an active OneLens account with the MCP feature enabled.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OneLens to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OneLens to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.onelens.cloud/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OneLens MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OneLens provides these MCP tools: get_cost_summary, list_dimension_values, list_dimensions, list_sources, and query_costs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OneLens?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to OneLens in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
OneLens requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OneLens is developed by Astuto AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
